REQ-VALIDATOR round 4 verdict: PASS. All eight round-3 findings (R1-R4, S1-S4) are resolved; I verified each by running the requirement's own commands. The rework introduced no new defect in testability, consistency, depends_on, sizing or the quality bar. From REQ-VALIDATOR's side, step 0 of criteria 14-15 may now start, then step 1. The run-time notes below are for ORCH and are not reworks.
Criteria are cited by number. The REQ-006 block was read from a frozen copy (17:12:41Z) that equals the live file through 17:21Z (cmp; mtime 17:10:43Z).

ROUND-3 FINDINGS
R1 resolved (criterion 14): line count, first-line guard and empty-hash guard.
 - Real file: Б6 has 148 lines, the first line matches, ac7e7b48... -> counts.
 - From tools/ with the wrong path, and on a CRLF copy: 0 lines, first-line match 0, e3b0c442... -> rejected. With ../docs/requirements.yaml -> counts. The guard gives 0 on a wrong first line.
R2 resolved (criteria 14, 10). Б5 has 33 lines and 44463bb3..., the same as in round 3. Changing REQ-005 criterion 4 gives 27e4fa49..., so it is caught, and Б6 is untouched. Editing REQ-001 or appending REQ-007 changes neither hash.
R3 resolved (criterion 15). Check (1) accepts real-like declarations and an extension line. It rejects a missing or empty serves, REQ-006 in first or last position, a missing own handoffs folder or one without the slash, and a date with a space or without Z. An empty file gives true.
 - <А> takes allows only from runs with handoffs: a declared run without handoffs gives 0 allows, and its change to docs/quality-bar.md fails snapshot-diff with exit 1.
 - Check (5): on copies of the real ISS-0001 (REQ-002/003/004) and PO (REQ-001) folders it gives an empty comm output. It catches a handoff naming REQ-006 and serves lacking an id.
 - Check (6): the earliest created_at is found.
 - bash and zsh give the same <А>. In zsh, a run without handoffs prints «no matches found» on stderr; this is harmless.
R4 resolved (criteria 4, 5, 6, 7, 17). T extracts exactly the 4 table lines and ignores a second table. The value_table round trip (stored without the final newline) gives an empty diff; the «рано» header check via jq gives 1; a table edited after 2a gives 2 diff lines. Criterion 5 adds result.checks and the step-4 re-review that leads to blocked «вердикт ворот оспорен» in either direction. Criteria 6 and 17 are consistent with it, and criterion 7 pins the table in the final document.
S1 resolved: control 1 gives exit 1 and exactly 3 added lines; control 2 gives exit 1 and exactly «changed docs/owner-goals.md»; control 3 gives exit 1 and exactly «removed docs/owner-goals.md». The copies built with zsh and with the ugrep wrapper are byte-identical to the BSD ones.
S2 resolved: the before-grep now includes pixel-office-brief and gives 0 on a fresh snapshot (220 files).
S3 resolved: «…-runN.json» in criterion 5.
S4 resolved: the date regex in check (1) works (see R3).

NO NEW DEFECTS; OTHER CHECKS
- Scope of the rework: comparing round 3 with round 4 criterion by criterion (cmp plus word diff), only the description and criteria 4, 5, 6, 7, 14, 15 and 17 changed, exactly as the analyst listed.
- The REQ-002..REQ-005 region is byte-identical to round 3 (121 lines). The REQ-006 header through original_request is identical to round 3 (27 lines). The analyst's prefix hashes reproduce (lines 1-325 f286465b..., 1-328 39cdf120...).
- Structure: ruby Psych parses REQ-001..006; REQ-006 is pending, depends_on [REQ-005], 19 criteria each with «Проверка:». The original_request quotes still equal reviews §4 and §3, and «Делай» is in §5.
- Protected set З: 30 lines, identical to the independent find+shasum listing and unchanged since my round-3 snapshot.
- Parallel run: the rewritten REQ-001 is consistent with criterion 14. It keeps its event log and secret in ~/.sai-pixel-office/, outside sai/, explicitly to keep the snapshot-diff valid. It says it will not change tools/src/snapshot.js or .claude/agents/, and that it declares its paths one by one, including .claude/settings.json.
- Every new grep gives identical results with the ugrep wrapper that agents' zsh uses.
- No speculation or bar-lowering words; both «позже» hits in REQ-006 are timing rules (criterion 6, criterion 15 check 6). No market fact is presupposed. Q8 and R3 are not applicable; Q10 is handled by SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; Q6 by З and Б being checked without tools/ plus the three controls.

NOTES FOR ORCH (step 0 and later; not reworks)
1. Declare every run that is active at snapshot time before step 1, each with serves covering all requirement_ids of its handoffs and with its own handoffs/<run_id>/:

 A run that finished before the snapshot needs no declaration.
